New Business Class on board our A350 and Boeing 787

In spring 2022 we introduced the first of four Airbus A350s that will gradually boost our long-haul fleet, and from this fall we will add more state-of-the-art aircraft, namely five Boeing 787 Dreamliners. An enhanced travel experience awaits you on board both aircraft types – an upgraded Business Class. Enjoy greater privacy and comfort, thanks to higher side panels and direct aisle access from every seat.
